[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T13:02:03Z, by staff] MarineMax to be Acquired by Francisco Partners
MarineMax, Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Francisco Partners in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $1.5 billion.
MarineMax, Inc. announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by the investment firm Francisco Partners. Under the terms of the proposed transaction, MarineMax shareholders are set to receive $53.00 per share in cash. The deal is valued at approximately $1.5 billion. This acquisition represents a significant change of control for the recreational boat and yacht retailer.
